summary.headline: Planetary Longitude and Spheres
summary.text: Explanation of planetary true position and longitude as the zodiacal arc from the beginning of Aries, defined by projection from the universe’s center through the planet to the highest sphere. Diagram labels describe the spheres, apogees, perigees, epicycles, deferents, eccentrics, nodes, and planetary configurations of the Sun, superior planets, Venus, Moon, and Mercury.
